discourse.title: The real birthday
discourse.excerpt: The day when you manifest pure feelings in your hearts, plant firm faith in the Divine Principle in your thoughts and cultivate unselfish enthusiasm to serve others, that day deserves to be celebrated as the Real Birthday.
discourse.theme: The real birthday is not the day the body was born — it is the day you manifest pure feelings, firm faith and unselfish enthusiasm to serve.

reflection: On his own birthday Swami redirects the celebration: do not mark the body's birth with pomp, mark the day your heart becomes pure, your faith firm, and your service unselfish. Today, celebrate by doing exactly that — one pure-hearted, unselfish act of service, offered quietly. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 17, 23 Nov 1984)
